name: Aurora Optoelectronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Aurora Optoelectronics Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese firm primarily focused on the research, development, production, and sale of sapphire crystal materials and associated equipment. Beyond its core offerings, the company also provides a variety of processing machinery, including equipment for material treatment, polishing, flat grinding, edge grinding, milling, and engraving, as well as specialized 3D glass hot bending machines. The company was founded in 2006 and operates from its base in Harbin, China.
